verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, covered by its SLA. A migration skill moves client code to the latest major version across ten languages (including C# and Scala), which signals actively maintained versions. Framework coverage via InstantSearch (vanilla JS and React in the docs; Vue, Angular, iOS and Android per community) is independently praised. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of release cadence or version currency per SDK, and independent hands-on corroboration of the backend language clients (community praise centers on InstantSearch).
